sentences.text:
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
June 11, 2024 42 Ardr Crr 2142 of 2024 Ishan Mohammad Vs. The State of West Bengal & anr.
Adv. Rituparna De Ghosh, Adv. Siddhartha Paul, Adv. Souradeep Ghosh, ... for the petitioner.

The petitioner seeks quashing of proceeding being Cgr case no. 802 of 2024 pending before the
learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, South 24 Parganas under Sections 406/420/506 of the Indian
Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there was a commercial transaction between the parties and the allegations leveled against the petitioner are false and frivolous.
The petitioner has submitted a supplementary affidavit which discloses issuance of notice under Section 41A of the Code upon the petitioner.
The petitioner intends to cooperate with the investigation and comply with the notice.
The supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner is taken on record.
Upon consideration of the submission made on behalf of the petitioner, this Court is inclined to hold that the petitioner has been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the application upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 30 th August, 2024.

In the event the petitioner cooperates in investigation of the case and meets the Investigating Officer in reply to the notice issued upon him under Section 41A of the Code, no coercive action be taken against the petitioner in connection with the present proceeding till 31st August, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties upon compliance of all necessary formalities.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
